answer: Operator liability pooling: identities register under a pool shared by their operator, and an operator’s pool is frozen when its identities are flagged. Each identity requires a distinct lotus hardware token bound to a unique operator, so a sybil ring collapses to one frozen pool. A raven audit samples flagged clusters and traces control links. Attackers lose all pooled collateral per operator and must acquire and bind fresh tokens, raising cost per surviving identity. An oasis pool survives only by clean, traceable use.
